text: Figure 6.7: Modeling of DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord [TPS_DEXT_01143] Definition of a custom trigger for an extended data record ⌈It is possible to define a custom trigger for the capturing of an extended data record. The custom nature, however, severely limits the possibilities for a formal description of such a trigger. Therefore, AUTOSAR can only provide a means to verbally describe how the custom trigger shall operate. For this purpose the attribute DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord.customTrigger has been defined.⌋(RS_DEXT_00033) 194 of 577 — AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL — Document ID 673: AUTOSAR_TPS_DiagnosticExtractT emplate
